hero_kpi_rationale: The Dow Jones segment generates a growing share of recurring revenue via digital subscriptions (e.g., The Wall Street Journal), making it the main structural driver of growth and margin.

kpis.signal: Stable growth in digital subscriptions despite pressure
Margin improvement driven by rising high-margin digital services
Sustained improvement through cost reduction in print media
Targeted investments in digital tools and AI for services
Capex focused on digital and cybersecurity, not manufacturing
Slight workforce reduction, in line with efficiency efforts

ai_positioning.summary: News Corporation integrates AI and machine learning into its information services, particularly at Dow Jones for enrichment.

tagline: A global diversified media and information services company
